title: Joint urea–creatinine structure and serum urate: an inconclusive incremental prediction test across public survey recruitment waves
abstract: Joint logBUN–logcreatinine structure did not establish incremental serum urate prediction in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transport (5,184 source;4,672 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.00224684 (mg/dL)², joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval [-0.00806579,0.00377063].
